title: AHB Wait-State Domino Effect
description: An INCR4 write burst shows how a stalled data phase freezes the following address phase and delays every later beat.

annotations.message: A1 starts the burst at 0x50. No data phase exists yet.
D1 is stalled by HREADY=0. A2 at 0x54 is visible but cannot be accepted, so HTRANS, HADDR, and D0 must hold.
HREADY rises: D1 completes and the held A2 address is finally accepted at the same edge.
D2 completes without a wait state while A3 at 0x58 is accepted.
D3 stalls. A4 at 0x5C becomes the frozen next address phase.
The second wait cycle continues. A4, HTRANS=SEQ, and D2 all remain stable.
HREADY rises: D3 completes and the held A4 address is accepted.
D4 completes for 0x5C while the address phase returns to IDLE. The INCR4 burst is finished.
